description: This Java source file defines the ProductConfigWorker class, which contains utility methods for handling product configuration logic such as caching, retrieving, storing, and loading product configuration wrappers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ProductConfigWorker
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for managing product configuration wrappers, including caching, retrieval, storage, and loading functionalities.

methods.name: getProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductConfigWrapper instance for a given product, considering cache and request context.

methods.name: fillProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Populates a ProductConfigWrapper with user selections and comments from the HTTP request.

methods.name: storeProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Persists the current configuration represented by a ProductConfigWrapper into the database, either by finding an existing configId or creating a new one.

methods.name: loadProductConfigWrapper
methods.description: Creates and loads a ProductConfigWrapper based on a given configuration ID, facilitating restoration of product configurations.
